help.title: Help
help.description: One desktop hub for Codex accounts, quota visibility, providers, and switching workflows.
help.overview.title: Everything in one place
help.overview.description: Local-first tools for everyday Codex work
help.multi.title: Multi-account management
help.multi.description: Sign in with ChatGPT or import auth.json and compatible exports; keep plans, notes, and expiration dates organized.
help.switch.title: Reliable account switching
help.switch.description: Atomically update the auth.json used by Codex, with quick switching available from both the app and system tray.
help.usage.title: Quota and usage insights
help.usage.description: Review 5-hour and weekly windows, reset credits, activity heatmaps, and a floating current-account meter.
help.providers.title: Providers and models
help.providers.description: Manage Responses or Chat Completions providers, model lists, API keys, and direct or local-proxy switching.
help.automation.title: Automation and proxy
help.automation.description: Schedule usage refreshes and optionally let the local proxy pick an available official account when quota runs out.
help.personalize.title: A workspace that fits
help.personalize.description: Choose language, theme color, privacy mode, Dream Skin themes, and your preferred floating-meter behavior.
help.quickStart.title: Three steps to get going
help.quickStart.description: The shortest path from setup to a working switch.
help.quickStart.step1: Add an account by signing in or importing a credential file.
help.quickStart.step2: Refresh usage and review the account's quota windows.
help.quickStart.step3: Select Switch; restart ChatGPT if the running session still uses cached credentials.
help.security.title: Local-first, with cloud sync under your control
help.security.description: Credentials stay behind the Rust backend and are never exposed to the React UI or app logs. Cloud sync is optional and should only be enabled with a server you trust.
help.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
help.faq.description: A few answers that prevent most detours
